name: Ali Azmat Butt
description:
'''Ali Azmat Butt''' (born 20 April 1966) is a [[Pakistani]] singer-songwriter, musician and actor. He is best known as the [[Lead vocalist|lead singer]] for the influential [[Sufi rock]] band [[Junoon (band)|Junoon]] and for his subsequent solo career, followed by an acting career.

In 2001, with Junoon, he became part of the first Pakistani band ever to perform at the [[United Nations General Assembly]].
